gettingstarted.title: Getting started with the platform
gettingstarted.markdownText:
## Getting started with the platform

Welcome to **DigiTwinXR SIOS** - your spatial intelligence operating system for climate risk and infrastructure analysis.

Quick start:

1. Search for a location to quickly find an area of interest
2. Use **Explore Intelligence** to view available data layers and intelligence modules
3. Interact with layers in your workspace
4. Click on map features to view detailed intelligence data
5. Change basemap using **Map Settings** for optimal visualization
6. Use controls on the right to zoom, tilt, and navigate the 3D view

stepbystepguide.title: Step by step guide
stepbystepguide.markdownText:
## Step by step guide

Launch a step by step guide for various popular workflows below:

step1.markdownDescription: The search is at the top of the workspace on the left.
step1.title: Search for a location to find an area of interest

step2.markdownDescription: You can view the intelligence catalogue at any time
step2.title: Use "Explore Intelligence" to view available modules

step3.markdownDescription: Find a dataset or intelligence module of interest
step3.title: Search or browse the intelligence catalogue

step4.title: Add layers to your workspace by clicking + or "Add to view" in preview window

step5.title: Interact with layers, adjust opacity and toggle visibility in your workspace

step6.title: Click on map features to view detailed intelligence data

step7.title: Change your basemap using options in "Map Settings" to improve visualization

step8.title: Zoom and change view using the controls on the right-hand side of the screen

satelliteimagery.title: Adding earth observation imagery
satelliteimagery.footnote: Important: Satellite imagery can take a little while to load so please be patient. If images don't seem to be loading, zoom out a little bit

step1.title: Find the location to view imagery
step1.markdownDescription: - Use the location search or zoom and pan around the map using your mouse or the zoom controls

step2.title: Add the imagery to your workspace
step2.markdownDescription:
- Open the intelligence catalogue using **Explore Intelligence** button
- Navigate through modules to select your satellite option: Landsat or Sentinel, and daily or composite images. This can depend on resolution of the image you need (10m or 25m) and whether you want daily, 16 day composite, or annual average images
 - Select **Add to view** to view the imagery

step3.title: Filter images to find the right coverage
step3.markdownDescription:
- Filter images by location to quickly find imagery for that location
 - Satellites circle the globe many times a day. You can expect imagery to be available for one location every two weeks
 - If you haven't already selected your point of interest on the map, zoom in to select one. You will see the filter applied in blue in your workspace on the left

step4.title: Select a time and date
step4.markdownDescription:
- Use the date picker to select a time and date. Cycle backwards through previous years using the back arrow
 - Choose another date if your imagery is obscured by clouds. You can quickly cycle back and forward using the arrows next to the date picker

comparetimeseries.title: View and compare different points in time
comparetimeseries.footnote: Important: Any time series data can be compared using the Split Screen Mode, not just imagery

step1.title: Add a time series dataset to your workspace
step1.markdownDescription:
- Earth observation imagery is a good example of time series data, with many satellites going back decades
- Find your location of interest and filter available imagery by this location
-See our Adding Earth Observation Imagery guide for more

step2.title: Select the time and date
step2.markdownDescription:
- In the workspace on the left, select the time and date which will open the date picker
- Select a year, month and date, or navigate back to other years and even centuries using the back arrow
- Available dates appear in blue

step3.title: Compare different dates at one location
step3.markdownDescription:
- From the 3 dots drop-down menu in the workspace, press 'Compare' to activate Split Screen Mode
- A duplicate copy of your layer will appear in the workspace
- Choose the dates you want to compare on the left and right of the screen
- Drag the slider using the white button to swipe and compare the two image dates

step4.title: Close Split Screen Mode
step4.markdownDescription:
- Escape the Split Screen Mode by pressing the 'x' of Split Screen Mode title in the workspace
- Remove the duplicate copy of your layer in the workspace using the 3 dots drop-down menu

helpContentTerm2.content: A sequence of data collected over different points in time, e.g. temperature sensor data or a gallery of images of the same location

helpContentTerm3.content: The panel on the left side of the screen that shows what layers you have added to your view

helpContentTerm4.content: 3D data that also has a time-series component

helpContentTerm5.content: The inventory of all intelligence modules and datasets available to be added to your workspace

helpContentTerm6.content: Different map options for the blank base map, such as Bing imagery, roads, dark or light maps

helpContentTerm7.content: The layer you added to your workspace that allows for difference calculations

helpContentTerm8.content: The way the dataset appears in the preview window. We recommend true colour to search for cloud-free images
